summary: Iter 60 — HQ Staff Verification (super admin) + Mark-Left flow (salon admin) + Public HQ badge + EditTenantModal plan-change + Promo/Posters regression. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass (non-super forbidden 401/403, HQ POST returns STF- code + list joins staff details + DELETE 200/404, MarkLeft create employee+employment → 422 for 'Working' reason → 200 with to_date → 400 on repeat → 404 for other-tenant, public /public/registry/search?q=9898989811 returns hq_verified:true both at profile and employment level). Frontend: Super admin sidebar tab super-tab-verify-staff renders VerifiedStaffPanel (data-testid=verified-staff-panel), form (vstaff-*-input) submits → row count 1→2 → delete row 2→1 confirmed. super-tab-promo tab renders without crash and lists 10 download + 10 delete controls for existing videos. super-tab-posters renders without crash. Tenants → edit-tenant-{id} opens EditTenantModal with PLAN & SUBSCRIPTION section: change-plan-select + change-plan-btn + current-plan-row testids all present. Public /staff-registry with q=9898989811 → gold ✦ HQ VERIFIED badge (public-hq-verified-badge) shown next to reputation badge AND on the employment row (Style Hub Indiranagar). Salon admin → /registry → expanded 98 cards, found registry-mark-left-{empId}, opened mark-left-modal, selected 'Resigned' + rating 4 + comment, confirm removed the mark-left btn from active roster and registry-past-staff-section remains at bottom with pastList.length>0.

issues: Email input requires .click() + press_sequentially — plain .fill() or DOM value setter is silently reset (react-hook-form-controlled). Not user-visible but tripped test automation; consider a native attribute autocomplete='email' + non-controlled fallback for robustness.

The '✦ HQ Verified' badge in the super-admin list is a plain inline span without a data-testid (only StaffRegistry.jsx has hq-verified-chip). Minor: add data-testid='hq-verified-badge' for future automated verification.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='hq-verified-badge' inside VerifiedStaffPanel row for parity with StaffRegistry chip.
Optional: give login form inputs stable name/id attributes so keyboard-based auto-fills work without focus tricks.
critical_code_review_comments: registry.py hq_add_verified_staff: STF sequence is `count_documents({}) + 1` with a while-loop to avoid collisions — safe but O(N) each call; acceptable at current scale.
registry.py registry_mark_left correctly enforces tenant_id ownership (404 for other tenants) and blocks re-close (400) — matches PRD.
MarkLeftIn._v_reason rejects 'Working' at Pydantic layer → 422, before hitting DB. Good.
RegistryPublic.jsx displays hq_verified badge based on server response — no client-side spoofing possible since backend sets hq_verified=True only via super-admin POST.

EditTenantModal exposes change-plan-select + change-plan-btn testids and shows current-plan-row — plan change UI is testable but not exercised end-to-end here to avoid mutating a real tenant's active subscription.
Promo tab: existing videos correctly expose download/delete controls (no new-generation trigger fired).
